rule: explicit age of at least 18 years
normalized gold diagnosis absent from case_prompt
at least two numbered diagnostic-reasoning points
single diagnosis label without slash, semicolon, or 'and'
selection.length_policy: No case_prompt length restriction. Length affects runtime, not clinical eligibility.
selection.review_note: Regex eligibility is not clinical validation; partitioning and leakage still require review.

source_records_file.values_policy: Original columns and field values only; no dialogue conversion fields were added.
